Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. As a new graduate engineer, you will work across the stack to build and improve AI-powered product features, own projects end-to-end, and collaborate directly with product, design, and customers to ship impactful software quickly.
Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Responsibilities
Design, build, and ship full-stack features using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python
Own projects from initial idea through deployment, monitoring, and iteration
Work directly with customers to understand problems and turn feedback into product improvements
Build systems that power AI agents, real-time collaboration, and enterprise-scale workflows
Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of our platform
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute thoughtful code reviews
Learn from experienced engineers while taking on meaningful ownership from day one

Required
• Are completing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
• Have strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and software design
• Have built software through internships, research, open source, startups, or personal projects
• Love solving difficult technical problems and learning new technologies
• Are excited to work across the stack
• Thrive in fast-moving environments where engineers take ownership and make product decisions
• Enjoy collaborating with teammates and communicating technical ideas clearly
• Can work from our San Francisco office at least three days each week
Preferred
Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, or Python is a plus, but not required
